ex.en: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression
[Hud] said, "O my people, there is not foolishness in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds

Those will have lost who killed their children in foolishness without knowledge and prohibited what Allah had provided for them, inventing untruth about Allah. They have gone astray and were not [rightly] guided

forms.gloss: to make a fool of oneself

ex.en: And who would be averse to the religion of Abraham except one who makes a fool of himself. And We had chosen him in this world, and indeed he, in the Hereafter, will be among the righteous
